title: Senoia The Walking Dead Film locations 2 hours Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy a 2 hour walk around the beautiful town of Senoia, GA. Your guide is Senoia Rick, a Rick Grimes cosplayer and look-a-like. You’ll see locations used in The Walking Dead, including Woodbury, Alexandria, Carl’s pudding house and more. We’ll also touch on other film projects, like Fried Green Tomatoes, The Conjuring 3, Agatha All Along, and others.
